## Read the inputs
```{r}
TcellObj <- readRDS(paste0(Inputdir,"LymphoidcellsUpdated_WithAnn_Nocls6.rds"))
NeutroObj <- readRDS(paste0(Inputdir,"Neutrophils.rds"))
MacroObj <- readRDS(paste0(Inputdir,"Macrophages.rds"))
EpiEndFibObj <- readRDS(paste0(Inputdir, "PIPSeq_Final_UsedForScanpy.RDS"))
DimPlot(EpiEndFibObj)
DimPlot(MacroObj)
DimPlot(NeutroObj)
DimPlot(TcellObj)
```
